newsitem.title: FRANCE: French plan for Cr Lyonnais to go to EU soon - paper.
newsitem.headline: French plan for Cr Lyonnais to go to EU soon - paper.

text.p: After continual delays, the French government's privatisation plan for state-controlled bank Credit Lyonnais will soon be submitted to the European Union competition authorities for clearance, daily Les Echos said on Tuesday.
The newspaper said the bank and the government had finally reached agreement on the text. But it said negotatiations with the European Commission in Brussels on the plan would take several months.
Under the plan, originally due to be sent to the Commission in February, a large part of the bank's European network will be sold in exchange for the Commission's approval of state aid.
The bank almost collapsed in the early 1990s under the weight of lending excesses before it was bailed out by the state.
Government comment was not immediately obtainable, nor was comment from the bank.
The centre-right government hopes to privatise the bank by late 1998 or early 1999.
